title: India's Police to Monitor 15,000 Suspected Sex Offenders in Tamil Nadu Based on Their Race
summary: The police in Tamil Nadu are planning to monitor around 15,000 suspected sex offenders based on their race as part of a new project. The initiative aims to improve the safety and security of women and children in the state. However, concerns have been raised about the potential for racial profiling and its impact on marginalized communities.
summary_points: The police in Tamil Nadu are planning to monitor around 15,000 suspected sex offenders based on their race as part of a new project.
The initiative aims to improve the safety and security of women and children in the state.
Concerns have been raised about the potential for racial profiling and its impact on marginalized communities.
The project's focus on race-based monitoring has sparked debate about its effectiveness and fairness.
The Tamil Nadu police department has not commented on whether the project will be implemented as planned.
